return lookupDb.Database.SqlQuery<GrupoOpcion>(@"SELECT g.ID AS Id, g.CubaID,
                    COALESCE(NULLIF(c.MatriculaCuba, N''), NULLIF(c.Codigo, N''), N'Cisterna') + N' / ' +
                    COALESCE(NULLIF(tg.NombreGrupo, N''), N'Grupo') +
                    CASE WHEN cp.Numero IS NULL THEN N'' ELSE N' - Comp. ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), cp.Numero) END +
                    CASE WHEN s.LadoCubaNombre IS NULL THEN N'' ELSE N' - ' + s.LadoCubaNombre END AS Texto
                FROM gaillard.Grupo g
                INNER JOIN gaillard.Cuba c ON c.ID = g.CubaID
                LEFT JOIN gaillard.TipoGrupo tg ON tg.ID = g.TipoGrupoID
                LEFT JOIN gaillard.Compartimento cp ON cp.ID = g.CompartimentoID
                LEFT JOIN gaillard.Situacion s ON s.ID = g.SituacionID
                WHERE ISNULL(c.Baja, 0) = 0 ORDER BY c.MatriculaCuba, tg.NombreGrupo, cp.Numero").ToList()
                .Select(x => new SelectListItem { Value = x.Id.ToString(), Text = x.Texto, Selected = selected == x.Id });

snippetModel.unrestricted:
return db.AccesoriosGrupo
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(ag => ag.Accesorio)
                .Include(ag => ag.Accesorio.TipoAccesorio)
                .Include(ag => ag.Grupos)
                .Include(ag => ag.Grupos.Cuba)
                .Include(ag => ag.Grupos.Compartimento)
                .Include(ag => ag.Grupos.Situacion)
                .Include(ag => ag.Grupos.TipoGrupo)
                .OrderBy(ag => ag.Accesorio.Nombre)
                .ThenBy(ag => ag.Grupos.Cuba.MatriculaCuba)
                .ThenBy(ag => ag.Grupos.Compartimento.Numero)
                .ToList()
                .Select(ag => new SelectListItem
                {
                    Value = ag.ID.ToString(),
                    Text = ObtenerTextoAccesorioGrupo(ag),
                    Selected = seleccionado.HasValue && ag.ID == seleccionado.Value
                })
                .ToList();

END ;WITH AccesoriosLegacy AS ( SELECT t.ID AS TareaMantenimientoID, TRY_CONVERT(INT, LTRIM(RTRIM(n.value('.', 'nvarchar(20)')))) AS AccesorioID FROM ( SELECT ID, AccesoriosNecesarios FROM dbo.TareasMantenimiento WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccesoriosNecesarios)), '') IS NOT NULL ) t CROSS APPLY ( SELECT TRY_CAST('' + REPLACE(t.AccesoriosNecesarios, ',', '') + '' AS XML) AS XmlAccesorios ) x CROSS APPLY x.XmlAccesorios.nodes('/i') s(n) ) INSERT INTO dbo.TareaMantenimientoAccesorios (TareaMantenimientoID, AccesorioID, Cantidad) SELECT DISTINCT l.TareaMantenimientoID, l.AccesorioID, 1 FROM AccesoriosLegacy l WHERE l.AccesorioID IS NOT NULL AND ( OBJECT_ID('gaillard.Accesorio', 'U') IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gaillard.Accesorio a WHERE a.ID = l.AccesorioID ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TareaMantenimientoAccesorios a WHERE a.TareaMantenimientoID = l.TareaMantenimientoID AND a.AccesorioID = l.AccesorioID );"; Feature.0004.description: Classic EntityFramework initialization needs to be adjusted in .NET Core.
Feature.0004.label: Classic EntityFramework initialization needs to be adjusted in .NET Core

Feature.1000.description: Convert application initialization code from Global.asax.cs to .NET Core and clean up Global.asax.cs.
Feature.1000.label: Convert application initialization code from Global.asax.cs to .NET Core and clean up Global.asax.cs

Feature.0003.description: GlobalFilterCollection is not supported in .NET Core and needs to be converted to the corresponding middleware registrations on the application object.
Feature.0003.label: GlobalFilterCollection is not supported in .NET Core and needs to be converted to the corresponding middleware registrations on the application object

Feature.0002.description: Routes registration via RouteCollection is not supported in .NET Core and needs to be converted to the route mappings on the application object.
Feature.0002.label: Routes registration via RouteCollection is not supported in .NET Core and needs to be converted to the route mappings on the application object

Api.0001.description: La API es binariamente incompatible con la versión de .NET seleccionada: afecta a los archivos binarios existentes y suele requerir recompilación, porque la API ha cambiado de forma que impide que los binarios antiguos se carguen o ejecuten.
Api.0001.label: Binario incompatible para la versión de .NET seleccionada

Api.0002.description: La API es incompatible a nivel de origen para la versión de .NET seleccionada: requiere cambios en el código para compilarse correctamente cuando se dirige a una nueva versión, como eliminar API obsoletas o cambiar las firmas de los métodos.
Api.0002.label: El origen no es compatible con la versión de .NET seleccionada

Api.0003.description: La API tiene un cambio de comportamiento en la versión de .NET seleccionada: el código y los archivos binarios pueden comportarse de forma diferente en el runtime sin necesidad de recompilación, pero el nuevo comportamiento podría no ser deseable y requerir actualizaciones.
Api.0003.label: Cambio de comportamiento en la versión de .NET seleccionada

LegacyConfiguration.description: Legacy XML-based configuration system (app.config/web.config) that has been replaced by a more flexible configuration model in .NET Core. The old system was rigid and XML-based. Migrate to Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration with JSON/environment variables; use System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager NuGet package as interim bridge if needed.
LegacyConfiguration.label: Legacy Configuration System

SystemWeb.description: Legacy ASP.NET Framework APIs for web applications (System.Web.*) that don't exist in ASP.NET Core due to architectural differences. ASP.NET Core represents a complete redesign of the web framework. Migrate to ASP.NET Core equivalents or consider System.Web.Adapters package for compatibility.
SystemWeb.label: ASP.NET Framework (System.Web)

Binding.0005.description: Manual binding redirects exist but are missing a redirect for a referenced assembly with a version mismatch. This can cause MissingMethodException or FileLoadException when the missing redirect allows the app to start but fails when a specific code path is hit.
Binding.0005.label: Missing binding redirect for referenced assembly

Binding.0006.description: An explicit binding redirect targets a different version than what auto-generation would produce. MSBuild will throw MSB3836 conflict error because it cannot determine which redirect wins.
Binding.0006.label: Manual redirect conflicts with auto-generated version

Binding.0007.description: A binding redirect's newVersion is lower than the version provided by the NuGet package. This forced downgrade usually causes a load failure at runtime because the expected assembly version is not available.
Binding.0007.label: Binding redirect forces version downgrade
